traps.description: thumbnail-cache was deployed 30 minutes earlier and logs a cold start with a 12% hit ratio, suggesting a bad deploy pushed extra load onto image-resizer; but image-resizer's request rate is flat and its memory had been climbing for five days

Rejected oversized uploads and a past incident about 60 MB photos crashing the decoder suggest bad input; those uploads are rejected cleanly by the size check and the kills are memory-limit OOMs after 117 h of uptime
